//: The browser now asks its own origin for the API (see api-config.ts). On :4200 that origin is the dev server, so it has to forward /api and the JWKS document to the gateway on :8000 -- exactly what Caddy does in compose and on Railway, and what a rewrite does on Vercel. Without this, `ng serve` would ask itself for /api/football and get its own index.html back.
